items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: I know you've heard of Bunk.

ctx.x: I know you've heard of Bunk.

Yes. I said, I'm at the Spallestown. And Brundy was good. That's right, I was thinking about Douglas. I don't know. I think... I don't know whether Douglas died here, but when I came here with Douglas had been dead. I know after the band, I went away. I didn't know what... I didn't know too, but I just done forgotten right now.
